
   chainlock

  What would you like to do?

  › 1 Seal    Lock a file so it opens only after a delay
    2 Open    Wait out a lock and decrypt its file
    3 Extend  Make a lock take longer to open
    4 Bypass  Open a locked file at once with its saved key
    5 Info    Show a lock's details and check its files
    6 Bench   Time this machine to see how long locks take

  file: notes.txt

  ↑/↓ choose · enter select · 1–6 open · q quit
